page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.14xlarge is an instance type within the Big data family configured on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The server provides 56 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, with no onboard GPUs.

Local storage is the defining characteristic of this instance, which bundles 165356 GB of mechanical hard disk drive capacity. Network performance is provisioned with a 35 Gbps baseline bandwidth, enabling high-volume intra-cloud and cluster data transfer. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the virtual machine, requiring separate network allocation for public connectivity.

The integration of over 165 TB of local spinning disk storage provides immense raw capacity at a low hardware cost per terabyte compared to solid-state alternatives. However, the reliance on rotational media trades off random read and write IOPS performance in favor of sequential bulk storage. This resource balance makes the server suitable for distributed big data processing frameworks like Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark, sequential data ingest pipelines, log processing, and data warehouse infrastructure.
